WITH matching AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_kinds pk ON pv.product_kind_id = pk.product_kind_id
  JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id
  WHERE pv.brand = 'Osram'
    AND pk.product_kind_name = 'LED Bulb'
    AND pf.product_family_name = 'Osram Eco Classic 3PW-R88 LED Bulb'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties vp1 WHERE vp1.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND vp1.property_key = 'Wattage' AND vp1.property_value_text = '15 W')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties vp2 WHERE vp2.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND vp2.property_key = 'Luminous Flux' AND vp2.property_value_text = '806 lm')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, (SELECT record_path FROM matching LIMIT 1) AS sample_path FROM matching;
